program:
PARAMS = {
    "kf":    (1.13, 0.95, 1.45),
    "qb":    (0.97, 0.75, 1.15),
    "kp":    (1.0, 0.75, 1.35),
    "c2":    (0.3e-12, 0.12e-12, 1.0e-12),
    "c3add": (2.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 6e-12),
    "itail": (45e-6, 20e-6, 58e-6),
    "gmid_in": (16, 10, 20),
    "L_in":  (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
}

def _hmag(f, wc, Q, wp):
    s = 1j * 2 * PI * f
    h = (wc * wc / (s * s + s * wc / Q + wc * wc)) / (1 + s / wp)
    return abs(h)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl   = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm  = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd  = 1.8

    wc = 2 * PI * 1.5e6 * p["kf"]
    Q  = p["qb"]
    C2 = p["c2"]
    C1 = 4 * Q * Q * C2
    R  = 1.0 / (wc * math.sqrt(C1 * C2))
    wp = p["kp"] * wc
    C3 = p["c3add"]
    Ctot = cl + C3
    R3 = 1.0 / (wp * Ctot)

    imax = 0.9 * 140e-6 / vdd - iref
    itail = min(p["itail"], imax)
    Lt, gmid_t, Lp = 0.5, 12, 0.5
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    mr = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=0.6)
    ratio = itail / iref
    mp = lut.size("p", 10, Lp, itail / 2, vds=vdd - vcm)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mr.W * ratio, Lt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "n2", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "oa", "oa", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "oa", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "oa", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2)
    n.R("R3", "oa", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", C3)

    gm = m1.gm
    A0 = gm / (m1.gds + mp.gds)
    cload = C1 + mp.cdd + m1.cdd + mp.cgd
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * cload)

    g0 = _hmag(1.0, wc, Q, wp)
    target = g0 / math.sqrt(2.0)
    lo, hi = 1e3, 1e9
    for _ in range(100):
        mid = math.sqrt(lo * hi)
        if _hmag(mid, wc, Q, wp) > target:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    fc = math.sqrt(lo * hi)

    pk = g0
    k = 0
    while k < 2000:
        fk = 10.0 ** (3.0 + 6.0 * k / 2000.0)
        v = _hmag(fk, wc, Q, wp)
        if v > pk:
            pk = v
        k += 1
    peaking = 20.0 * math.log10(pk / g0) if pk > g0 else 0.0

    hs = _hmag(10.0 * fc, wc, Q, wp)
    atten = -20.0 * math.log10(hs / g0)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)

    return n, {"fc": float(fc), "atten_db": float(atten), "peaking_db": float(peaking),
               "gain_db": float(20.0 * math.log10(A0 / (1 + A0))), "power": float(power),
               "gbw_info": float(gbw), "a0_info": float(20.0 * math.log10(A0))}
